moments.hook: WHY CAN YOU VOTE FOR YOURSELF?
moments.label: Trent
moments.title: Flamingo Votes Himself Out of Total Drama

moments.label: Sadie

moments.why: A dramatic and funny reaction to being voted out early while being insulted by the other players.

moments.why: Funny interaction where he realizes his 'best friend' Katie is actually on the opposing team.

moments.label: Heather
moments.title: Flamingo Celebrates Heather's Loss

moments.label: Heather
moments.title: Flamingo Begs Heather for Mercy

moments.title: Flamingo Accuses Beth in Total Drama
